claims.text: High-entropy alloys exhibit superior tribo-corrosion degradation resistance compared with conventional structural alloys.
The proposed superiority of high-entropy alloys applies under combined elevated-temperature and tribo-corrosion conditions.
High-entropy alloys have a multi-principal-element composition.
The multi-principal-element composition of high-entropy alloys enhances the formation of protective oxide layers.
The multi-principal-element composition of high-entropy alloys improves their mechanical properties.
Protective oxide formation and improved mechanical properties reduce the degradation rate of high-entropy alloys relative to conventional structural alloys.
High-entropy alloys provide longer service life than conventional structural alloys under the specified conditions.
